profile.headline: Computer Software Engineer
profile.summary: Computer Engineer who loves learning new technologies. Always striving to create the best possible product while working with my team members to get it done as efficiently as possible. Aspires to help the world through programming with interests in healthcare and green energy.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working towards internationalization of Zio for Europe, Japan, and beyond

Engineering new scalable tools to ensure the quality of Zio Reports

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Full stack development building web-based applications with Vue.js, Java, and MySQL
Worked on an Agile team to develop applications used in the blood bank industry and successfully passed 510k regulations 
Developed the initial design for the overhauled 510k service utilized for the new AWS cloud application, streamlining the successful FDA approval of the new software.
Successfully lead development of a now deployed API used to connect existing iSeries DB2 applications to a modern phone application for donor engagement
Design and create REST API microservices using Spring Framework in java for new AWS Cloud applications, as well as MySQL database structures.
Optimize existing IBM iSeries legacy algorithms for migrating to an AWS cloud environment, significantly improving their efficiency and throughput (some from seconds to milliseconds)
Participates in code reviews and approvals to ensure sprint work is of high quality
Develop custom software requested directly from clients and worked with them to make sure they got what they wanted
Troubleshoot and assist co workers who need assistance with a challenging problem
positions.insights: Skills: Back-End Web Development · Spring Boot · Programming · Computer Engineering · JavaScript · MySQL · Java · Spring Framework · Cloud Computing · Optimization

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Researched, developed, and tested distributed machine learning algorithms in R, C, and Scala
Explored online and offline methods for cluster computer based data parallel algorithms with aims to optimize performance.
Developing custom functionality for a custom proprietary compiler in C++.
Analyzed and reported performance characteristics of machine learning and A.I. algorithms in Flink, Spark, and in-house processing engine.

positions.title: Facilitator
positions.description:
Paid student teacher position for running supplementary classes where I create worksheets for students to complete, followed by a walk through of solutions.
Taught a total of 6 classes over 2 years in the subjects of:
Discrete Mathematics, Data Structures, Algorithms

positions.title: Workshop Facilitator
positions.description: Teach and help students learn about computer science topics (Programming, discrete math)

projects.description: Proof of Concept: Collecting Wind Speed and Direction from a mobile platform in real time.
